subject: Feasibility review: Acme Health private deployment (VPC/on-prem) - readiness & staffing
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-07-28 09:15 -07:00
Subject: Feasibility review request - Acme Health private deployment (VPC + on-prem)

Team —

Acme Health (pilot account) wants a private deployment option combining a customer VPC peering layer for control plane and an on-prem inference runtime in one of their data centers. Their commercial ask: 99.9% uptime SLA, HSM-backed KMS integration, and 3rd-party managed install support.

Could we get a quick feasibility read for:
- Architecture gaps (KMS, audit logging, network/topology)
- Minimum staffing and SRE/oncall needs for pilot (3-month runway)
- High-level timeline and cost drivers (non-binding)
- Any likely compliance showstoppers (SOC2, data residency)

I attached the current VPC readiness checklist with Acme's answers. Please reply with owners/ETA. If we need an exception/approval matrix, flag it.

Attachments: vpc-readiness-checklist.xlsx

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Product Manager, Redwood Inference
From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-07-28 11:02 -07:00
Subject: Re: Feasibility review request - Acme Health private deployment (VPC + on-prem)

Monica —

Thanks for the brief. I'll lead the technical feasibility and pull together a one-page summary for Sales/Legal. Quick notes up front:
- Neha, can you call out compliance must-haves and whether we need a formal exception matrix?
- Vivek, please provide a rough FTE estimate for remote installs + 24/7 oncall coverage for the pilot. List what requires full-time vs contractor.
- Laura, can you confirm any contractual constraints (e.g., explicit KMS/HSM ownership clauses) from the Acme side?

I'll draft the initial timeline by EOD Friday and attach a staffing stub for review.

Sean Gallagher
Head of Infrastructure, Redwood Inference

---Attachment: staffing-estimate-stub.csv (referenced)---
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Vivek Kullarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-07-29 08:47 -07:00
Subject: Re: Feasibility review request - compliance blockers and evidence needs

Sean/Monica —

High level compliance items we need to clear before greenlight:
1) SOC 2 evidence for hosted control plane: Acme requires audited SOC2 report for the control plane that touches customer metadata. If we cannot provide an audited report, Legal will need to evaluate an exception.
2) KMS/HSM: We need a documented integration path for customer-managed KMS (bring-your-own keys). If HSM is required, confirm supported HSM vendors and whether key escrow is permitted.
3) Audit logs & retention: Define what logs are exported to Acme's SIEM and retention controls.
4) Data residency: On-prem runtime should ensure no tokens or PII are copied back to hosted systems without explicit opt-in.

I'll prepare a minimal "exception matrix" draft listing which items can be mitigated by contract vs which need product changes. Attaching the initial draft.

Neha Kapoor
Security & Compliance, Redwood Inference

---Attachment: exception-matrix-draft.xlsx---
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-07-30 14:30 -07:00
Subject: Re: Feasibility review request - infra notes, timeline, and ops asks

Team —

Architecture/ops notes from a quick scan:
- Two supported installation modes: (A) VPC peering + managed runtime in customer's private cloud, (B) On-prem appliance with outbound-only telemetry to our control plane. Each has different tradeoffs for latency and SLA.
- KMS/HSM: We'll need to add a KMS adapter for customer HSMs (estim. 4-6 engineer-weeks to support 2 vendors).
- Network: Firewall rules + NAT traversal for metrics/control channel. Expect 1 week of engineering per site for network testing/validation.
- Oncall: Pilot needs a 1.0 runbook and 24/7 oncall rotation. Recommended staffing: 0.5 FTE SRE (pilot coordinator) + 1 contractor for installs per site during rollout weeks. Post-pilot: 0.2 FTE recurring ops per customer for monitoring/patching.
- Timeline: Pilot (single DC) estimate: 8–10 weeks from order (includes security review and legal counters).
- Cost drivers: HSM integration, travel/third-party install, oncall burn, and support SLAs.

I created a short ops estimate (attached) and opened a Jira ticket for tracking: INF-1337.

Vivek Kulkarni
Infrastructure Engineering Lead, Redwood Inference

---Attachment: ops-estimate-remote-install.pdf---

Thanks for the fast turnaround. Acme is aligned to proceed with a pilot if we can: (1) produce the exception matrix for Legal to review, (2) confirm the 8–10 week pilot timeline, and (3) provide a staffed plan for installs + 24/7 support for the pilot duration.

Action items we agreed with the customer in today's sync:
- Redwood: deliver exception matrix + 1-page feasibility summary by 2027-08-05 (Sean + Neha + Vivek).
- Acme: provide KMS vendor details and internal SOC2 contact by 2027-08-03 (Maria/Tara).
- Joint meeting: schedule technical kick on 2027-08-10. I'll send an invite after internal sign-off.

Maria/Tara — copying you to confirm the KMS vendor and SOC2 contact. Please reply with contacts or the right doc links.

Laura Bennett
Strategic Accounts, Redwood Inference
